provenance.method: Bounded first-party review for the Organisations & peer community UK v1 reference slice; inclusion records identity, access and scope without endorsing quality, safety or outcomes.

name: British Dyslexia Association Dyslexia Charity Network
description: Postcode-searchable network of local and national not-for-profit dyslexia charities, with activity descriptors such as helplines, meetings, webinars and peer-support groups.
intended_use: Finding local or national dyslexia support organisations without treating directory inclusion as a personal recommendation.
audience_or_context: People affected by dyslexia in areas covered by the network; the reviewed directory explicitly provides local entries and national groupings for England, Scotland and Wales.
limitations: The reviewed directory is strongest for England, Scotland and Wales and must not be presented as complete Northern Ireland coverage.
Activities, opening times and local-group status can change; check the individual entry and organisation.
Directory presence does not establish peer-led governance or service effectiveness unless separately evidenced.
cost_or_access_notes: Browsing and postcode search are public; listed charities can have their own fees for assessments, tuition or other services.
